day_shape: 81 items: CENTCOM begins 11th consecutive night of strikes on Iran with US blockade redirecting 8 vessels, Hegseth puts war cost at $37.5bn, Trump threatens Pickaxe Mountain site, FCDO statement on Houthi Saudi threats, heavy Khamenei/IRIB messaging cycle.

threads.label: US strike campaign and blockade of Iran
threads.summary: CENTCOM said it began an 11th consecutive night of strikes on Iranian military targets to degrade threats to Strait of Hormuz shipping, and reported 8 commercial vessels redirected and 1 disabled under the US blockade. Pentagon spokesperson Sean Parnell said nearly 100 US service members had been wounded since hostilities renewed, and Israeli officials told the Jerusalem Post Trump was preparing to escalate.

threads.label: Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site in focus
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Israeli intelligence assesses Iran has moved thousands of centrifuges to the deeply buried Pickaxe Mountain site near Natanz, after Trump threatened to strike it. Iran International and Jerusalem Post published explainers on whether the facility can be disabled.

threads.label: Diplomacy, overflight rows and third-country pressure
threads.summary: Rubio said the US remained open to diplomacy and that mediators had offered Iran a 10-day ceasefire which Tehran rejected, while IRIB claimed Spain forced 5 US tanker aircraft to reroute and Iran International reported Bulgaria moving to allow US refuelling flights. France summoned Iran's chargé d'affaires over the detention of embassy staff in Tehran, and Iran warned Turkey and Azerbaijan against joining strikes.

threads.label: US war cost and UK/allied basing
threads.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth told the Senate Appropriations Committee the war with Iran had cost $37.5 billion so far and requested a $1.5 trillion defence budget. Jerusalem Post reported newly sworn-in UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham approved use of British bases for US strikes on Iran.

threads.label: Lebanon track: Aoun-Trump, southern border friction
threads.summary: Trump met Lebanese President Aoun at the White House — the first such visit in 17 years — and lifted a flight ban in place since 1985, while the IDF said it fired warning shots after Lebanese Armed Forces personnel crossed 150 metres into its buffer zone at Zawtar al-Sharqiyah. The Lebanese army confirmed the incident during pilot-zone deployment.

threads.label: Gaza operations and Houthi Red Sea threat
threads.summary: The IDF said it killed Hamas cell commander Osama/Asma Kamal Shehadeh Abu Teim, who took part in the Nir Oz abductions on 7 October 2023, and struck Islamic Jihad operatives moving weapons in southern Gaza, while confirming a 23km sand barrier inside Gaza. The FCDO issued a statement on Houthi threats against Saudi Arabia including a maritime blockade, and Iran International reported Saudi tankers reversed course after a Houthi Bab el-Mandeb blockade declaration.

threads.label: Regime messaging and internal Iranian politics
threads.summary: Khamenei's office and IRIB pushed heavy wartime messaging including a condolence note for the 'Mozafar martyrs' and army chief Hatami's Isfahan speech, while Defa Press claimed Iranian forces hit Amazon's Bahrain cloud zone and an American base in Kuwait. Iran International reported a hardliner accusing Speaker Ghalibaf of paving the way for a 'bloodless coup' via a US deal, criticism of FM Araghchi's interview, and two death sentences in Shiraz plus the secret burial of teenage protester Erfan Esfandiyari.

events.title_en: Reduction of doctoral programme duration and exemption of top students from comprehensive exam. Head of Higher Education Planning Office, Ministry of Science: The doctoral programme is set to become shorter and more effective through two solutions: first, reducing the number of courses and second, requiring universities to deliver courses in the first two semesters. Through this measure, students will be able to enter the research phase from the third term. Certain indicators such as grade point average, scientific papers and top students' research activities will replace the comprehensive examination.

Honourable Mr. Hossein Mozafar, Peace be upon you; I express my condolences on the passing of your esteemed mother, the sacrificing and patient mother of the honoured martyrs Hasan, Ali and Reza Mozafar (may God's mercy be upon them), to you and the other respected survivors and the families of the martyrs and those who have sacrificed. This esteemed and devout lady, by raising children faithful and committed to defending the sanctity of the Islamic Revolution, has attained the exalted station of divine proximity.

events.summary: Iran's leading economists warned Monday that renewed conflict with the United States risks pushing the country's long-festering economic problems into a more dangerous phase, arguing that inflation is becoming increasingly difficult to contain.

events.title: Araghchi interview draws fire from Iran hardliners
events.summary: Criticism of Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi's recent interview has spread across Iranian conservative media, with critics arguing he disclosed sensitive information about wartime security and internal decision-making following its publication this week.

events.title: A Hamas terrorist who took part in abducting Nurit Cooper, Amiram Cooper, and Alexander Dancyg from Kibbutz Nir Oz during the October 7, 2023, onslaught, was killed in a strike earlier this week, the IDF announces. The strike on Sunday in the southern Gaza Strip killed Osama Kamal Shehadeh Abu Teim, a commander of a cell in Hamas's military wing. On October 7, Abu Teim raided Nir Oz and took part in abducting the three hostages, according to the military. The IDF says that during the war and recently, Abu Teim acted to advance attacks on troops and Israeli civilians, and he was therefore targeted.
